method.ownership_external_sort_work_dir: --audit-work-dir / ORRERY_AUDIT_WORK_DIR; unset, std::env::temp_dir(), which is RAM-backed tmpfs on systemd hosts
notes: The fixture uses one Shape-C item transfer, two balance deltas, and one ownership transition per receipt.
The Parquet byte count is measured from encode_receipt_object; the ownership entry size is size_of::<OwnershipEvent>() in this build.
The external merge sort retains one 4,096-event run plus 16 run heads, so its ownership-event HEAP working set is 4,112 * 56 = 230,272 bytes, independent of transitions retained.

The same sort spills every transition as a fixed 42-byte record (OWNERSHIP_RUN_RECORD_BYTES) to the work directory and holds it until the pass ends, so its SPILL is transitions * 42 and scales with the window. A consolidation stage transiently holds one merged output batch beside its unconsumed inputs, so the work directory needs under twice the spill free (#912).
The pre-#912 version of this artifact reported only the heap bound as per-pass memory; on the default tmpfs work directory the spill is resident memory too.

audit::conservation::tests::thirty_day_synthetic_archive_stays_inside_ownership_memory_ceiling exercises 30 page-sized archive objects through the multi-stage merge and asserts the stated 256 KiB heap ceiling.

identity.reason: ReceiptBalanceDelta and ReceiptOwnershipTransition carry AccountId directly.

layout_verdict.daily_24h_window: the ownership re-sort heap is bounded at 224.875 KiB (230,272 bytes), below the 256 KiB stated ceiling; its spill is 1.79118 GiB (1,923,264,000 bytes) on the work directory for the pass, resident memory if that directory is the default tmpfs; scan volume remains a separate capacity concern
layout_verdict.full_30d_retention: the sweep still reads about 100.67 GiB per full pass; the ownership re-sort heap remains 224.875 KiB rather than growing to 71.65 GiB, while its spill grows with the window to 53.73538 GiB (57,697,920,000 bytes) on the work directory
layout_verdict.chosen_shape: #890 uses a bounded external merge sort over the captured receipt objects. It preserves full-window findings without a new tailer-side archive object or a carried item cursor.
layout_verdict.spill_failure: #912: whole-window balance, effect-shape, and conservation findings are emitted before the ownership merge spills, and a spill failure returns them inside FullSweepFailure; a full work directory is a reported pass failure that still names any conservation break, never a clean pass
